correctness.rationale: Direct composition of f0 and f1_delta produces the four affine branches with thresholds a=delta/2, t=2/3−a, b=1−delta. For a<x<b, normalized z=(x−a)/(b−a) obeys Q(z)=z/2 for z<2/3 and 2z−1 otherwise, strictly decreases to zero; outside the gap P is identity. Bounded convergence implies every P-invariant Borel measure lives on the fixed set; the half-interval exchange reconstructs exactly all h-invariant and ergodic measures and pointwise empirical limits. Exact inverse-branch lengths give 4−6delta; at 2/3 P=id and every basin is null. Expanding first-hit tails give P(K>=k)=1/(3·2^(k−1)). Verified four-branch substitution for 5 rational delta values on 1000-point exact grids; this does not substitute for the all-real proof.
